# glinet_repeater (Resource)

Manages the options of the repeater, the Wi-Fi uplink of the router (`repeater.set_config` in the router API). The router has one repeater configuration, so use one instance of this resource.

~> **Warning:** when the uplink of the router is the repeater, a band lock to a band without the uplink network can cut the Internet access of the router and its clients. It is not known whether a change of `switching_mode` makes the repeater connect to another saved network at once.

The resource does not connect the repeater to a network and does not change the saved networks. After the write, the provider reads the configuration again and stops with an error when the router did not apply it. The write of this resource was not tested on a router; the parameters come from the router's web UI. Destroy removes the resource from the Terraform state and does not change the router.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glinet_repeater" "this" {
  switching_mode = "auto_switching"
  lock_band      = ""
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `lock_band` (String) Band that the repeater uses (`lock_band` in the router API), for example `2g` or `5g`, or `""` for all bands. The bands depend on the router model. The web UI shows this option only on a router with two or more bands. For `""`, the write has no `lock_band`, as in the web UI. It is not known whether such a write removes a band lock on the router. When it is not set, the provider writes the router value.
- `switching_mode` (String) What the repeater does with the other saved networks (`auto` in the router API): `no_switching` (`0`), `auto_switching` (`1`) or `auto_switching_without_network` (`2`). The names come from the label keys of the web UI (`repeater.no_switching`, `repeater.auto_switching`, `repeater.auto_switching_without_network`). The web UI code does not tell the exact behaviour of each mode. Firmware 4.7.0 gives a bool, which the provider reads as `auto_switching` (`true`) or `no_switching` (`false`); it is not known whether firmware 4.7.0 accepts a number in the write. When it is not set, the provider writes the router value. The state has no value when the router gives a code that is not in this list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `repeater`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is always "repeater".
terraform import glinet_repeater.this repeater
```
